# Xenophanes of Colophon

*570 BCE – 475 BCE · Greek*

A wandering poet from Colophon, he mocks the gods of Homer and Hesiod, made in the image of humans. Against them he sets a single god who moves all things by thought, and distinguishes what one knows from what one believes.
